title: Genesis Block Wallet Puzzle

author.name: anonymous (on-chain only, OP_RETURN messages to the escrow)

prize.note: 24 P2WSH outputs to one witness script; the jackpot grows because the author relays every paid question into the escrow (125,779 sats on 2026-08-24, 142,779 on 2026-08-29, 168,779 on 2026-09-12)

target_format: P2WSH v0; witness script OP_2 <keyA> <keyB> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG; both keys derived from one genesis-block field (reported: the coinbase text) without hashing; the author's derivation rule names the BIP48 levels m/48'/0'/account'/script_type'

derivation.summary: derive two secp256k1 keys from one field of the genesis block (author's hints: the coinbase text readable in The Times, no hash, keys independent, a BIP48-shaped path with a genesis value as account), build the 2-of-2 witness script in either key order, sha256 it, and compare with the published 32-byte witness program
derivation.certified_against: the BIP-173 P2WSH test vector, and a real 2-of-2 P2WSH spent in block 963629 (tx 47ded3504e855ce418e46eeca4694b55a623d1e23a8e3c83292abbcf9cee9f7a, input 0) whose revealed keys rebuild the script and hash to the spent address; private key 1 to the generator point; negative control against the escrow

difficulty_note: the lock is fully characterized (2-of-2 P2WSH, exact offline oracle) and the corpus is 285 public bytes; passes 1 and 2 (2026-08-29) exhausted the mechanical readings of the August hints (611,008 keys, 5.7e11 ordered pairs, 0 match with witnesses); the author's answers of 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11, bought by a reader with the questions drafted here, name the root: a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic with entropy taken from the genesis block, a passphrase, and a genesis value as the BIP48 account; pass 3 (2026-09-12, 1.57 million keys, 2.46e12 pairs, witnesses re-found) shows the passphrase is none of 53 obvious readings of the block; it is the one thing the author has not described

leads.title: ask the author about the passphrase's nature on chain (79-byte draft in the README); pass 3 shows it is none of 53 obvious readings of the block
pass 3 wave 2: text variants and every coinbase-text substring as passphrase
watch the escrow for new OP_RETURN hints or a spend before any work
pass 3: 16-byte genesis windows as 12-word entropy, 53 passphrases, genesis integers as BIP48 account, script types 0/1/2, keys paired (2.46e12 pairs)
pass 2: library-specific roots (hashed roots, raw 64-byte extended key, raw key with zero chain code) along the same 214 paths
pass 1: literal readings of the 2026-08-28 hints, families A to D
